description: DPRK Foreign and Domestic Tourism Visitor Counts & Status (2018-2026)

pre_pandemic_baseline_2018_2019.notes: Peak year 2019 following Xi Jinping visit to Pyongyang. Banned US passports since 2017.

post_pandemic_reopening_timeline.key_markets: Russia (Vladivostok to Pyongyang & Masikryong Ski Resort via Air Koryo / Vostok Intur)
post_pandemic_reopening_timeline.wonsan_kalma_status: Under construction; Kim Jong Un inspected July 2024, announced target opening May 2025.

post_pandemic_reopening_timeline.key_markets: Russia (Vostok Intur handled ~4,000 tourists). China cross-border day trips resumed selectively in Rason.
post_pandemic_reopening_timeline.wonsan_kalma_status: Opened July 1, 2025 (inaugurated June 24, 2025 by Kim Jong Un). 20,000 overnight guest capacity; operated almost exclusively for domestic citizens after brief Russian pilot visit in July 2025.

post_pandemic_reopening_timeline.key_markets: Russia (Air Koryo / Vostok Intur charter flights), selective Chinese business/border visitors in Rason.
post_pandemic_reopening_timeline.wonsan_kalma_status: Domestic operation active; foreign general tourism remains restricted through October 2026.
